tools.name: pricing
tools.description: Free. Return the price of every paid tool and of the HTTP invoice PDF route, the payment network (Base) and the receiving address. No input, no network request, no payment.

tools.name: validate_invoice
tools.description: Free. Validate an invoice JSON (the body for POST /v1/invoice.pdf, or the output of invoice_from_timesheet) and return computed subtotal, discount, tax and total, or a list of field errors. Same checks as the paid PDF route. Offline, no payment.

tools.name: payment_reminder_draft
tools.description: Draft a payment reminder email for one unpaid invoice in a friendly, firm or final-notice tone. Returns a subject, plain-text body, days overdue and a suggested next step. Use late_fee_calc first if you want the fee amount quoted in the email. Draft only: nothing is sent. Pure calculation: no networ

tools.name: late_fee_calc
tools.description: Calculate the late fee on one overdue invoice: flat fee, monthly % or annual %, simple or compounding, with optional grace days. Returns days late, the fee, the new total and a line to paste on the invoice. Use payment_terms_check instead to work out when an invoice is due. Not legal advice; it does

tools.name: payment_terms_check
tools.description: Work out the due date and status for payment terms such as Net 30, 2/10 Net 30, Due on receipt, EOM or Net 30 EOM. Returns the early-payment discount amount and deadline, the annualized cost of skipping the discount, and suggested reminder dates. Use late_fee_calc once the invoice is overdue. Pure c

tools.name: invoice_from_timesheet
tools.description: Turn time entries (hours x rate, with optional rounding, grouping by task and expenses) into a validated invoice JSON with totals, ready for POST /v1/invoice.pdf. Use validate_invoice (free) instead if you already have an invoice. Pure calculation: no network request, nothing is sent or stored. Cost

tools.name: receivables_health_report
tools.description: Grade the health of a business's accounts receivable from its invoice list. Send a CSV export (QuickBooks, Xero, FreshBooks, Wave, Stripe or any CSV with customer and amount columns; columns are auto-detected) or JSON rows, up to 1000 invoices. Returns an A-F grade and 0-100 score with reasons, agin

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_invoice, receivables_health_report · Public sink: validate_invoice, payment_reminder_draft, invoice_from_timesheet, receivables_health_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_invoice, receivables_health_report · Public sink: validate_invoice, payment_reminder_draft, invoice_from_timesheet, receivables_health_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "pricing" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "FREE. Prices, network and payment address for the paid tools, plus the HTTP invoice PDF route." → after: "Free. Return the price of every paid tool and of the HTTP invoice PDF route, the payment network (Base) and the receiving address. No input, no network request, no payment."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
